metadataLimits: No named nested official getMessagesByIds query completions in either saved snapshot; actual inner read-count reduction is unavailable, not zero.
Later snapshot reached original1000cap; earlier uncapped browser666snapshot preserved. Missing records are not recovered or assumed zero.
Client monotonic submission/paint/stdout and server epoch timestamps have separate origins; no cross-clock residual computed.
Cached queries retain original execution/user metadata; subtracting their old start from later completion is not current execution latency.
Engine/user/child/Action intervals overlap and must not be summed.
Durable row createdAt is mutation-fixed transaction time; mutation completion provides a later commit/response boundary.
Strict memory proof is bounded per-table reads, not one cross-table snapshot.
Native conflict table/writer/document digest is actual, but document contents and causal paid-operation identity remain private/unavailable.
